summary: A Brampton practice with direct billing and digital dentistry is a strength, but dead menu links and no visible hours appear to cost you new patients.

findings.problem: Main menu items Dental Services, Patient Info, News, Contact Us and Digital Dentistry appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Patients clicking the menu get nowhere, so they leave before finding your services.
findings.fix: Working menu pages for every section.

findings.problem: The Request a Consultation form appears to state 'simply a request, and not an actual appointment' and asks for a preferred date and time with no date field.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book cannot, and the form gives them no certainty.

findings.problem: The Opening Hours link appears to go to the contact page and no hours appear, and the map link appears to contain the placeholder 'Your+Location'.
findings.cost: Patients cannot see when you are open or get directions.
findings.fix: Visible hours and a correct map link.

findings.problem: The heading 'Why choose Earlsbridge Dental?' appears with no content under it, 'Our solutions includes' appears, and no patient reviews appear.
findings.cost: Empty sections, typos and missing reviews weaken trust.
findings.fix: Written benefits, proofread copy and real reviews.

redesign: Visible hours, reviews and clean copy.
